correctness.rationale: The twelve ordered-pair graph is explicit. Exhaustive face counts for scales 1 and 2 are (12,18,4) and (12,42,48,12). The complete F2 boundary rank witnesses are (11,4) and (11,31,12); these are rational lower bounds and equal exact upper bounds from graph connectedness, chain dimensions and boundary-composition zero. Thus rational H1 at scale 1 has dimension 3, rational H2 at scale 2 has dimension 5, and other positive degrees vanish. Signed Lefschetz enumeration for every one of the 24 S4 permutations gives H1 class traces (3,-1,-1,0,1), H2 traces (5,1,1,2,-1), which equal the sign-twisted standard and four-label permutation-plus-sign characters. Maschke semisimplicity identifies the rational modules; diameter three gives all other threshold intervals. A separate exact rational matrix check agreed. The packaged verifier regenerates and checks all counts and formulas.

value.rationale: The 2023 Platonic-solid Rips study explicitly proposes Archimedean solids and flags the conflict between symmetry and ordinary Morse collapses. A canonical Archimedean graph has already-known nonequivariant positive barcode dimensions 3 and 5, but those dimensions conceal the group action. The new complete rational S4-valued barcode shows an orientation-sign-twisted standard dying degree-one representation and a degree-two birth decomposing into one invariant class, one sign class, and one standard three-dimensional summand. These are substantive distinctions of isometry actions and can inform comparisons of symmetry-aware Rips filtrations. No generalization or integral claim is asserted.
